pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal geometries with high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level transitions. Larger, more elongated dark regions are situated on the neck, while smaller, more fragmented patches are observed on the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-pigmented negative-space network forming a continuous topological graph. High junction node density with predominantly tri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank with slight pixel-level diffusion at patch boundaries.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible 1D mane contour along the upper neck with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations appearing as short, repetitive vertical projections against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized thinning and height reduction in the mane profile is visible at the junction where the posterior neck meets the shoulder ridge.
